Standard Agent Action Reference.name: Standard Agent Action Reference
Standard Agent Action Reference.description:
Standard actions are included by default with your agents. Many standard agent actions
    are available to all users who have permission to access Agentforce. Other standard actions are
    built to work with specific clouds or products, so they require an additional license or
    permission. When you add a standard action to your agent, customize the action for your use
    case, including the underlying flow, prompt template, or other reference action.
